TestPerPartitionRateLimiting::test_write.description: 1 node RF=1. With only a read limit set, 200 writes/s to one partition must see no rejects; with max_writes_per_second=10, accepted rate must be in (5,16)/s; with the limit kept, writes to always-new partitions must see no rejects. Guards per-partition write limiting and that it is per partition, not per table.
